name: traces_server_request_drop_anomaly
title: Server request volume dropped
description: The number of SERVER spans per five-minute bucket across the whole traces stream is below its learned weekday/weekend hour-of-day band in at least 2 of the last 3 buckets. Unit: spans per 5 minutes. Whole stream; add a service_name filter after install for a per-service alert (one config per service). Needs applications sending OpenTelemetry traces to the traces stream named default.
